user_request: Judge using publicly available online information without waiting for a game environment
scope: Targeted Japanese, English and Korean web searches plus retrieved article text; not an exhaustive survey or a controlled game experiment

sources.kind: reported official broadcast skill text, not independently inspected game footage

supports: one target can receive multiple sequential attacks

sources.caution: Retrieved skill line repeats nearest-to-crosshair wording, omits the unlocked-enemy filter and labels the target capacity with an ammunition unit. Do not interpret transcription defects as alternative game rules.
Retrieved text does not specify crosshair proximity. Absence from an abbreviated summary is not evidence against the published acquisition rule.

unresolved: screen projection versus 3D distance to aim ray
do_not_substitute: single-target repeated attacks as duplicate acquired handles
decision.research_restart_condition: A source with a discriminating controlled test or an explicit numerical specification; another copy of the same skill text is insufficient
